changes.positiveEvidence: Sagelio's current official site advertises pricing control to the host location and visibility on 50+ charging apps. Its 2026 official pricing article explicitly explains how each customer/site should choose the tariff charged to drivers from its own energy cost and desired return, stating that there is no tariff valid for everyone. The 0.59 EUR/kWh shown there is explicitly an illustrative example, not a network tariff.
